text: {"label": "Behavior Analysis's Role in Autism Treatment","definition": "Work on how applied behavior analysis as a discipline relates to autism: practitioners' treatment choices, beliefs and intensity recommendations, responses to critiques, care coordination, insurance review, and extending practice beyond autism.","distinct_from_neighbours": "Focuses on the field's identity, scope and practitioner decision-making, not on evaluating intervention effectiveness, addressing autistic people's developmental needs, or measuring service-delivery outcomes."}
